change: Clarify that 2K/4K/8K/16K input sweeps limit initial task plus evidence; continuations have an explicit 32768-input-token ceiling and all tokens are counted. Output cap is per call. The full-history and compact-state comparisons share the same continuation ceiling.
reason: A 4K output followed by real feedback cannot fit back into a 4K total prompt without losing task/history. No mandatory text or hidden truncation is allowed.

change: The 12 initial policies are in policies.json. Fixed policy budget/position/source-availability sensitivity probes are diagnostic axes, not additional learned prompt candidates; no diagnostic oracle may become the deployment policy.
reason: Separate architecture search from controlled context-length tests. All comparison results, including failures and missing runs, remain reported.

change: Program-only and program-execution use the same JSON interface containing code plus a claimed numerical answer. Execution replaces the claim with the actual computed value; it never changes the code or supplies mathematical gold.
reason: Isolate arithmetic execution from the benefit/cost of prompting the model to write a program.

stage: after round 2 validation; before any final test
change: Repeat validation for incumbent routed and reading/knowledge contenders across all three preregistered seeds. The primary numerical promotion and stopping rules do not change.
reason: Identical prompt/seed produced different outputs when batch composition changed. Unchanged-contract deltas are serving/sampling variation, not a causal effect of the edited component. vLLM 0.23.0 GDN backend does not advertise batch-invariant support; retain the same ordinary BF16 backend for both models rather than silently changing only the student.

stage: after finite validation selection; before final sealing
change: Final evaluation uses a fixed batch size and max sequence count of 128 for all models/arms, with the same BF16 eager backend and declared per-call token caps. Four frozen removal/review controls are evaluated but cannot enter policy selection.
reason: Use available GPU throughput for three-seed final comparisons; preserve 18 searched policies and count every returned call, including retries. Development latency and final latency use different batch sizes and are not directly comparable.
